movies.title: Obsession
movies.description: The viral indie sensation the internet cannot stop memeing — watch it immediately.
movies.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

movies.title: Disclosure Day
movies.description: Spielberg's brand new alien thriller featuring a career-best performance from Emily Blunt.
movies.overview: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.

movies.title: The Mandalorian and Grogu
movies.description: This is the way! Star Wars finally returns to the big screen tonight.
movies.overview: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

movies.title: Backrooms
movies.description: A24’s youngest director turns the internet's creepiest liminal space into full-blown terror.
movies.overview: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

movies.title: Scary Movie
movies.description: The classic Wayans spoof is back, and no 2020s horror hit is safe.
movies.overview: Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer's crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe.

movies.title: Citizen Vigilante
movies.description: Banned, viral, and aggressively debated — the movie everyone's shouting about on X.
movies.overview: A man takes justice into his own hands, hunting down criminals. His vigilante crusade makes him a social media star but puts him at odds with the local police chief.

movies.title: Heartstopper Forever
movies.description: Devastating and sweet. The final cinematic chapter has fans completely in tears.
movies.overview: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.

movies.title: The Furious
movies.description: Insane martial arts choreography that John Wick fans will absolutely drool over.
movies.overview: After a criminal network kidnaps Wang Wei's daughter and the corrupt police refuse to assist him, Wei sets out on his own to locate her. Navin, a tenacious journalist whose wife has mysteriously vanished, is his only ally. In this explosive martial arts showdown, the unlikely duo fights the kidnappers ruthlessly driven by a furious vengeance.

movies.title: Exit 8
movies.description: The viral loop game gets a terrifying, mind-bending live-action cinematic adaptation.
movies.overview: A man trapped in an endless sterile subway passageway sets out to find Exit 8. The rules of his quest are simple: do not overlook anything out of the ordinary. If you discover an anomaly, turn back immediately. If you don’t, carry on. Then leave from Exit 8. But even a single oversight will send him back to the beginning. Will he ever reach his goal and escape this infinite corridor?

movies.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
movies.description: Miranda and Emily go head-to-head in this highly anticipated, ultra-glamorous sequel.
movies.overview: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.

movies.title: Enola Holmes 3
movies.description: Millie Bobby Brown returns with her sharpest, most charming mystery caper yet.
movies.overview: Adventure follows detective Enola Holmes to Malta, where her plans to tie the knot unravel when Sherlock's disappearance plunges her into a perilous case.

movies.title: The Sheep Detectives
movies.description: Hugh Jackman stars in the delightfully weird family mystery the internet loves.
movies.overview: George Hardy is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

movies.title: Tuner
movies.description: White Lotus star Leo Woodall shines in this tense, sleek heist thriller.
movies.overview: A gifted piano tuner's meticulous skills for tuning pianos lead him to discover an unexpected aptitude for cracking safes, turning his life upside down.

movies.title: Iron Lung
movies.description: YouTube legend Markiplier makes his highly anticipated, blood-red directorial debut.
movies.overview: In a post-apocalyptic future where an event known as "The Quiet Rapture" caused all known stars and habitable planets in the universe to disappear, a convict is sent to search an ocean of blood discovered on a desolate moon, using a small submarine nicknamed the "Iron Lung".

movies.title: Michael
movies.description: The most discussed music biopic of the decade — see what the hype is.
movies.overview: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

movies.title: Project Hail Mary
movies.description: Ryan Gosling and Sandra Hüller shine in this epic, emotional sci-fi triumph.
movies.overview: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.

movies.title: Mortal Kombat II
movies.description: Brutal, bloody, and absolutely packed with the game's iconic characters.
movies.overview: The fan favorite champions—now joined by Johnny Cage himself—are pitted against one another in the ultimate, no-holds barred, gory battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

movies.title: In the Grey
movies.description: Guy Ritchie at his absolute loudest with Cavill and Gyllenhaal leading the charge.
movies.overview: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to take it back—an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and survival.

movies.title: Little Brother
movies.description: John Cena and Eric André team up for absolute chaotic comedy gold.
movies.overview: A tightly wound realtor's picture-perfect life gets an extreme makeover when his lovably chaotic "little brother" suddenly reappears.

movies.title: Voicemails for Isabelle
movies.description: A hilarious, genuinely sweet rom-com that will completely cure your dating fatigue.
movies.overview: A young woman's hilariously confessional voicemails to her late sister are unknowingly redirected to a stranger, who begins to fall in love from afar.

movies.title: Your Fault: London
movies.description: Tense, romantic drama across the pond that's already trending all over TikTok.
movies.overview: Nick and Noah are both embarking on life-changing adventures that are threatening to pull them apart—Nick in business with his father and Noah starting a fresh chapter at Oxford University. Now living separate lives, and meeting new people, they find themselves entangled in temptations, rivalries, and betrayals and their bond is tested like never before. As secrets unravel and temptation rises, they must fight to hold onto each other—or risk losing everything.

movies.title: Pressure
movies.description: Andrew Scott and Brendan Fraser in a nail-biting, claustrophobic World War II thriller.
movies.overview: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

movies.title: Deep Water
movies.description: A gripping, shark-infested survival nightmare that will make you dread the ocean.
movies.overview: A group of international passengers on a flight from Los Angeles to Shanghai is forced to make an emergency landing in shark-infested waters. The terrified group is forced to work together and overcome their differences if they hope to escape their sinking plane and the frenzy of sharks drawn to the wreckage.

movies.title: I Am Frankelda
movies.description: Stunning, spooky stop-motion horror that feels like a classic Guillermo del Toro fantasy.
movies.overview: A gifted young writer in 19th-century Mexico journeys into her subconscious and comes face to face with characters from her own spooky stories.

movies.title: Kraken
movies.description: A giant sea monster unleashes pure, wet chaos in this tense Norwegian thriller.
movies.overview: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see?

movies.title: Maternal Instinct
movies.description: A chilling, deeply unsettling true crime documentary that will leave you stunned.
movies.overview: Police pull over a woman who claims she just gave birth. But the baby — and the blood — aren't hers. Twisted lies unravel in this true-crime documentary.

movies.title: Colors of Evil: Black
movies.description: Tense, procedural Polish noir that will keep you guessing until the final frame.
movies.overview: Investigating the disappearance of children in a remote Polish town, prosecutor Leopold Bilski must unravel a sinister local legend before it's too late.

movies.title: Mexico 86
movies.description: Diego Luna stars in this vibrant, nostalgic heist comedy packed with historical fun.
movies.overview: When a last-minute chance to host the 1986 World Cup appears, a cunning Mexican bureaucrat, armed with nothing but guts and audacity, cons his way through FIFA to beat the United States, but in a country of power games, every victory has a price.

movies.title: Office Romance
movies.description: Jennifer Lopez and Brett Goldstein deliver perfect, laugh-out-loud romantic chemistry.
movies.overview: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees. When a new sexy lawyer begins working for her, that policy becomes very tested.

movies.title: The Marked Woman
movies.description: A dark, highly atmospheric psychological thriller that grips you and never lets go.
movies.overview: When a woman is found in a shipping container with no memory of who she is, two detectives race to figure out her identity — and who wants her dead.

movies.title: I Swear
movies.description: A powerful, heartbreaking historical drama that critics are calling an absolute masterpiece.
movies.overview: Diagnosed with Tourette Syndrome at 15, John Davidson navigates his way against the odds through troubled teenage years and into adulthood, finding inspiration in the kindness of others to discover his true purpose in life.

movies.title: Hokum
movies.description: Irish folk horror that builds a suffocating sense of dread from start to finish.
movies.overview: When novelist Ohm Bauman retreats to a remote inn to scatter his parents' ashes, he is consumed by tales of a witch haunting the honeymoon suite. Disturbing visions and a shocking disappearance forces him to confront dark corners of his past.

movies.title: The Last Viking
movies.description: Mads Mikkelsen is incredibly funny and brutal in this dark Nordic comedy.
movies.overview: After serving fourteen years for robbery, Anker is released from prison and reunites with his mentally ill brother Manfred, who alone knows where the stolen money is hidden but has forgotten its location, sending them on a journey to recover the loot and confront who they are.

movies.title: Over Your Dead Body
movies.description: Samara Weaving kicks absolute butt in this wild, hyper-violent action comedy.
movies.overview: A dysfunctional couple head to a remote cabin to "reconnect", but each has secret intentions to kill the other.

movies.title: Ladies First
movies.description: Sacha Baron Cohen and Rosamund Pike are a hilarious, chaotic comedy duo.
movies.overview: An arrogant but charismatic ladies' man finds his life of money, power and casual flings upended when he wakes up in a parallel world dominated by women.

movies.title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
movies.description: John Krasinski returns for one final high-stakes, explosive espionage mission.
movies.overview: Jack Ryan is reluctantly pulled back into espionage when an international covert mission unravels a deadly conspiracy. Racing against time, he joins CIA allies Mike November & James Greer and sharp MI6 officer Emma Marlowe to battle a rogue black-ops unit in a high-stakes, deeply personal fight.

movies.title: The Stranger
movies.description: François Ozon delivers a sleek, mysterious French thriller full of unexpected twists.
movies.overview: Algiers, 1938. Meursault, a quiet and unassuming employee in his early thirties, attends his mother's funeral without shedding a tear. The next day, he begins a casual affair with Marie, a work colleague. He quickly slips back into his usual routine.

movies.title: Normal
movies.description: Bob Odenkirk does his best John Wick impression in this gritty thriller.
movies.overview: An unassuming substitute sheriff with a troubled past responds to a bank robbery in a small, sleepy town and unknowingly uncovers something far more explosive.

movies.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
movies.description: The director of Evil Dead Rise delivers terrifying, relentless, and gory mummy horror.
movies.overview: The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without a trace—eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she is returned to them, as what should be a joyful reunion turns into a living nightmare.

movies.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
movies.description: A beautifully animated cosmic ride that Mario fans of all ages will love.
movies.overview: Having thwarted Bowser's previous plot to marry Princess Peach, Mario and Luigi now face a fresh threat in Bowser Jr., who is determined to liberate his father from captivity and restore the family legacy. Alongside companions new and old, the brothers travel across the stars to stop the young heir's crusade.

movies.title: Mother Mary
movies.description: Anne Hathaway and Hunter Schafer in a gorgeous, music-fueled psychological melodrama.
movies.overview: Long-buried wounds rise to the surface when iconic pop star Mother Mary reunites with her estranged best friend and former costume designer Sam Anselm on the eve of her comeback performance.

movies.title: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
movies.description: A massive, adrenaline-fueled Indian action epic that completely blows the roof off.
movies.overview: As rival gangs, corrupt officials and a ruthless Major Iqbal close in, Hamza's mission for his country spirals into a bloody personal war where the line between patriot and monster disappears in the streets of Lyari.

movies.title: The Crash
movies.description: A shocking, fast-paced true crime documentary detailing a devastating conspiracy.
movies.overview: A teen slams her car into a building, killing her boyfriend and his friend. What seems like a tragic accident becomes a murder case.

movies.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
movies.description: Jon Bernthal's brutal return to his most iconic and bloodiest role yet.
movies.overview: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.

movies.title: Faces of Death
movies.description: A modern, terrifying internet-age reboot of the infamous, highly controversial cult classic.
movies.overview: A woman, employed as a website content moderator, comes across a series of violent videos reproducing death scenes from a film.

movies.title: Remarkably Bright Creatures
movies.description: Sally Field is incredibly charming in this quirky, heartwarming mystery.
movies.overview: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

movies.title: Accidental Partners
movies.description: Warm, energetic Mexican rom-com with amazing leads and tons of chemistry.
movies.overview: Two women discover they were both scammed by the same man (who also got them pregnant). They form an alliance to take revenge.

movies.title: No Place to Be Single
movies.description: A cute, lighthearted rom-com perfect for a cozy date night in.
movies.overview: A brilliant and intelligent love comedy that celebrates second chances and new horizons, starring a strong and determined woman who settles the score.

movies.title: My Dearest Assassin
movies.description: Stylish action and burning romance clash beautifully in this highly energetic thriller.
movies.overview: Hunted for her rare blood type, a caged woman vows to fight alongside the assassin she loves to protect their future when an old enemy resurfaces.

movies.title: The Drama
movies.description: Zendaya and Robert Pattinson star in this deliciously twisted, chaotic romance.
movies.overview: A happily engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

movies.title: Ready or Not: Here I Come
movies.description: Samara Weaving faces off against another murderous family in this fun horror sequel.
movies.overview: Moments after surviving an all-out attack from the Le Domas family, Grace discovers she’s reached the next level of the nightmarish game — and this time with her estranged sister Faith at her side. Grace has one chance to survive, keep her sister alive, and claim the High Seat of the Council that controls the world. Four rival families are hunting her for the throne, and whoever wins rules it all.

movies.title: Swapped
movies.description: A delightful, visually inventive animated adventure that is perfect for families.
movies.overview: A small woodland creature and a majestic bird, two natural sworn enemies of the Valley, magically trade places and set off on an adventure of a lifetime to switch back. Their journey soon uncovers a greater threat—one that could endanger not only their species, but the entire valley they call home.

movies.title: Hoppers
movies.description: Pixar’s latest is a hilarious, touching adventure about animals and friendship.
movies.overview: Scientists have discovered how to 'hop' human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals, allowing people to communicate with animals as animals. Animal lover Mabel seizes an opportunity to use the technology, uncovering mysteries within the animal world beyond anything she could have imagined.

movies.title: They Will Kill You
movies.description: A wild, blood-soaked horror-comedy with great physical stunts and tons of style.
movies.overview: A woman answers a help wanted ad to be a housekeeper in a mysterious New York City high-rise, unaware that she is entering a community that has seen a number of disappearances over the years and may be under the grip of a Satanic cult.

movies.title: Apex
movies.description: Charlize Theron is a ruthless force of nature in this unrelenting thriller.
movies.overview: A grieving woman pushing her limits on a solo adventure in the Australian wild is ensnared in a twisted game with a cunning killer who thinks she's prey.

movies.title: Protector
movies.description: Milla Jovovich returns to action-hero glory in this tight, fast-paced survival thriller.
movies.overview: Nikki's life is shattered when her daughter is kidnapped. Thrust into the criminal underworld while hunted by cops and military, she must fight to rescue her child.

movies.title: Resurrection
movies.description: Bi Gan’s latest is a gorgeous, dreamlike sci-fi journey with Shu Qi.
movies.overview: In a future where humanity has surrendered its ability to dream in exchange for immortality, an outcast finds illusion, nightmarish visions, and beauty in an intoxicating world of his own making.

movies.title: Vengeance
movies.description: A slick, relentless Mexican action-thriller with great fight choreography and punchy pacing.
movies.overview: The brutal murder of the wife of “Toro,” a military hero in the special forces, turns him into a man with a single purpose: revenge. After a stroke of fate makes him a millionaire, Carlos transforms his fortune into an arsenal and, together with his closest soldiers, sets out to hunt down those responsible.

movies.description: A gritty, tense crime-thriller from South Africa that keeps you on edge.
movies.overview: When an unexpected road rage incident puts his son in critical condition, an enraged father spirals down a dark path of emotional turmoil and vengeance.

movies.title: Roommates
movies.description: A light, breezy college comedy with plenty of laugh-out-loud roommate chaos.
movies.overview: When shy college freshman Devon asks cool-girl Celeste to be her roommate, a blossoming friendship quickly spirals into a war of passive aggression.
